title: Constant component of the two-coordinate indicator
statement: Let $g$ be the indicator of $c$ on the equally weighted set $\{a,b,c\}$, and let $f(x_0,x_1)=g(x_0)g(x_1)$. The Fourier component of $f$ supported on the empty set of coordinates is the constant function with value $1/9$.
